meta.purpose: Locally-served demo catalog for the React storefront. Consumed only by scripts/serve-demo.mjs (VITE_API_URL points to it). Never deployed, never mirrored to production, no production credentials or URLs.

products.name: Aero Wireless Earbuds Pro
products.shortDescription: True-wireless earbuds with hybrid noise cancelling.
products.description: Featherlight true-wireless earbuds with hybrid active noise cancelling, transparent mode for commutes, and a pocket case that tops the buds up to 28 hours of total playtime. Sweat-resistant and stable for runs and calls alike.

products.name: Nimbus Smart Speaker Mini
products.shortDescription: Compact voice speaker for hands-free help.
products.description: A palm-sized smart speaker with crisp 360° sound, far-field mics for voice commands, and smart-home routines built in. Pairs with the app in seconds and streams over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.

products.name: Tempo Fitness Tracker Gen 2
products.shortDescription: Heart-rate and sleep tracker with 10-day battery.
products.description: Track steps, heart rate, sleep stages, and 20 workout modes from a featherweight wristband. Bright always-on display, 10-day battery, and the app builds trends you can actually read at a glance.

products.name: Arc USB-C Fast Charger 65W
products.shortDescription: GaN charger that powers a laptop and a phone.
products.description: A 65W gallium-nitride wall charger with two USB-C and one USB-A port. Compact enough for travel, fast enough for laptops, phones, and tablets, with full safety protection built in.

products.name: Lumen Touch Desk Lamp Smart
products.shortDescription: Dimmable desk lamp with app and timer controls.
products.description: A minimalist touch desk lamp with four colour temperatures, smooth dimming, and app schedules. The sturdy aluminium arm holds any angle, and the timer helps you keep a sensible work rhythm.

products.name: RetroCassette Bluetooth Speaker
products.description: A nostalgic cassette-shaped speaker with rich mono sound, Bluetooth 5, and a working tape deck for genuine tape playback. Fun to hold, louder than it looks, and a gift that gets a reaction.

products.name: Nordic Oak Coffee Table
products.shortDescription: Solid-oak table with a lower shelf.
products.description: A clean-lined coffee table in solid white oak with a slim profile and one handy lower shelf for magazines and remotes. The matte oil finish is a joy to touch and ages gracefully with use.

products.name: Aldo Accent Armchair
products.description: A compact accent armchair upholstered in soft boucle with a gently curved back and solid-wood legs. Small enough for a reading corner, comfortable enough to stay in for an evening.

products.name: Vega 3-Seater Fabric Sofa
products.description: A generously proportioned three-seater with a solid hardwood frame, feather-wrapped seat cushions, and fade-resistant linen-blend upholstery. The straight arms and barely-there legs keep it airy in any room.

products.name: Milo Two-Door Storage Cabinet
products.shortDescription: Tall cabinet with one shelf and one drawer.
products.description: A slim two-door cabinet in matte plywood with one adjustable shelf and one soft-close drawer. Just the right footprint for hallways and bedrooms, with a furniture-quality finish all around.

products.name: Breeze Outdoor Lounge Chair
products.description: A stackable outdoor lounge chair in weatherproof recycled slats on a powder-coated frame. It shrugs off sun and rain, dries fast, and stacks neatly against the wall between seasons.

products.name: Haven Queen Bed Frame
products.shortDescription: Upholstered bed frame with side panels.
products.description: A low-profile queen bed frame in upholstered fabric with a padded headboard and two slim side panels. Slat base included; tools and a steady partner are all you need to assemble it.

products.name: Axel Articulating Floor Lamp
products.shortDescription: Task floor lamp with adjustable arm.
products.description: A slim floor lamp with an articulating arm that swings the light exactly where you need it. Matte-black steel, a warm dimmable bulb included, and a weighted base that stays put.

products.name: Halo Ceramic Table Lamp
products.shortDescription: Glazed ceramic lamp with linen shade.
products.description: A rounded ceramic base with a soft glaze and a natural linen drum shade. The Halo casts a warm, flattering pool of light for bedside tables and console shelves alike.

products.name: Pendlo Dome Pendant
products.shortDescription: Single dome pendant with black cord.
products.description: A powder-coated dome pendant that throws clean, even light over dining tables and kitchen islands. Adjustable cord length and tool-free canopy fitting keep installation simple.

products.name: Frost Three-Head Ceiling Spot
products.description: A three-head ceiling spot in matte white with individually adjustable heads and energy-saving LED bulbs. A workhorse for halls and kitchens that disappears into the ceiling line.

products.name: Coil Brass Wall Sconce
products.description: A compact sconce in unlacquered brass with a subtle coil detail. It pairs beautifully in pairs and develops a soft patina over time, adding a warm glow to corridors and reading nooks.

products.name: Ely String Warm Lanterns 10m
products.description: A ten-metre string of twenty paper lanterns on a weatherproof cable. Indoor-safe and outdoor-tolerant, they turn a balcony or bedroom corner into a soft, festive glow.

products.name: Ceramic Bloom Vase S
products.shortDescription: Small glazed vase with organic glaze.
products.description: A small hand-finished vase with an organic glaze that pools in soft bands of colour. Sized for a grocery-store bunch or three stems of dried grass on a mantel or desk.

products.name: Woven Jute Wall Hanging
products.shortDescription: Textured jute wall art on a dowel.
products.description: A hand-woven jute wall hanging with layered fringes on a natural dowel. Texture-forward and quiet in colour, it fills an empty wall without shouting for attention.

products.name: Cobalt Throw Cushion 45cm
products.description: A 45cm woven cushion in deep cobalt with a hidden zip and plump recycled fill. Adds a confident pop of colour to sofas and beds, and hides its price tag on close inspection.

products.name: Rustic Mantel Mirror Set
products.shortDescription: Three mirrors with aged metal frames.
products.description: A set of three graduated mirrors in aged iron frames with a softly bevelled edge. Grouped over a mantel they open up the room and pick up the light beautifully.

products.name: Driftwood Photo Frame Trio
products.description: Three frames in mixed driftwood tones with simple glass and a stand or keyhole mount. A quick, tactile way to pin three good memories to a shelf or wall.

products.name: Marble Effect Candle Set
products.description: Four fluted pillar candles with a convincing marble effect and a clean, unscented burn. Sold as a set for tablescapes, fireplaces, and winter evenings.

products.name: Tri-Ply Stainless Skillet 26cm
products.description: A 26cm tri-ply stainless skillet with an encapsulated aluminium core for even heat and an oven-safe handle. From a gentle scramble to a proper sear, it does it all and cleans up in seconds.

products.name: Herb Chopper Pro
products.shortDescription: Rocker chopper with five curved blades.
products.description: A stainless rocker chopper with five curved blades that mince herbs, garlic, and nuts in a single brisk motion. The wide handle gives you a proper grip and a dishwasher-safe build.

products.name: Aero Pour-Over Kettle 1L
products.description: A one-litre gooseneck kettle with a slow, precise stream that makes pour-over coffee a habit. Cool-touch handle, easy-fill lid, and a shape built for control, not just looks.

products.name: LockBox Glass Storage Set (5pc)
products.shortDescription: Five glass containers with locking lids.
products.description: Five borosilicate glass containers with steam-vent locking lids in two sizes. See-through stock at a glance, oven-to-fridge ready, and lids that click shut without a fuss.

products.name: Chef's Forged Santoku Knife
products.description: A 16cm forged santoku with a laser-tested edge and a balanced octagonal handle. Feels heavier in quality than in hand and keeps a razor edge with a few weekly passes of the steel.

products.name: PrepMate Silicone Set (6pc)
products.description: Six heat-resistant silicone utensils on steel cores, from spatulas to ladles. Gentle on non-stick pans, comfortable to hold, and dishwasher-safe for an easy clean-up after every meal.

products.name: Verona Ergonomic Office Chair
products.description: An ergonomic office chair with adjustable lumbar, seat-depth, and armrests, plus a breathable mesh back for long sessions. The gas lift and lockable recline keep you moving while you sit.

products.name: Ober Height-Adjustable Desk
products.description: A sit-stand desk with a whisper-quiet dual-motor lift, three memory presets, and a cable tray underneath. The wide oak top fits two monitors plus all the usual desk clutter.

products.name: Compact Bamboo Organizer
products.shortDescription: Bamboo tray with dividers for a desk.
products.description: A bamboo desk organizer with configurable dividers for pens, post-its, and chargers. Warmer than plastic, clever with cable exits, and it sits put on the corner of any desk.

products.name: Focus Noise-Cancelling Headset
products.description: An over-ear headset with active noise cancelling, a boom mic that filters keyboard clicks, and twenty-hour battery life. Keeps calls clean and focus intact through a noisy open-plan day.

products.name: Tilt Articulating Monitor Arm
products.description: A gas-assisted monitor arm that lifts, tilts, and rotates any 13–32 inch screen with a clamp or grommet mount. Clamps up to 9kg, hides the cables, and frees your desk surface.

products.name: Novo Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swap switches, a milled aluminium plate, and south-facing RGB. Swap the switches without a soldering iron and thumb the satisfying spacebar.

products.name: Saffiano Leather Wallet
products.shortDescription: Slim wallet in pebbled saffiano leather.
products.description: A slim card-forward wallet in textured saffiano leather with eight card slots and a note sleeve. Ages like leather should and disappears into any pocket without a bulge.

products.name: Weave Canvas Tote
products.description: An oversized canvas tote with reinforced handles, an inner zip pocket, and a laptop sleeve that fits 15 inches. Baggy, durable, and the one bag that goes to market and meetings alike.

products.name: Nylon Tech Sling Pack
products.description: A weather-proofed nylon sling with an organisation-first interior, quick-access pocket, and a strap that adjusts for either shoulder. Small enough for the essentials, smart enough for travel days.

products.name: Minimal Steel Watch
products.description: A quiet, minimal watch with a brushed steel case, a clean dial, and a fine mesh strap. Slim enough under a cuff, sharp enough to be the only piece on show.

products.name: Reversible Leather Belt
products.shortDescription: Two-sided belt in black and tan.
products.description: A reversible full-grain leather belt that flips from black to tan without changing the buckle. One belt, two looks, and a brass buckle that holds where it sits.

products.name: Travel Passport Holder
products.description: A slim leather passport holder with three card pockets and an elastic band for boarding passes. Keeps the travel pile together and survives a hundred airport trays.

products.name: Rose Quartz Facial Roller
products.description: A hand-carved rose quartz roller with a stainless frame that glides cool and smooth over serum and moisturiser. A two-minute morning ritual that wakes the face without effort.

products.name: Hyaluronic Hydra Serum 30ml
products.description: A weightless 30ml serum with tri-weight hyaluronic acid and a calming-cica complex. Layers under sunscreen and makeup without piling, and drinks in fast on damp skin.

products.name: Shea Butter Night Cream
products.description: A rich overnight cream built on raw shea and ceramides that seals moisture in while you sleep. A small scoop goes far; skin wakes up supple, never greasy.

products.name: Velvet Lip Tint Set
products.description: Three buildable velvet lip tints in everyday neutrals with a creamy, non-drying finish. Sheer in one pass, full in two, and pigmented enough to survive coffee.

products.name: Cedar Trim Beard Oil 30ml
products.shortDescription: Beard oil with cedar and sandalwood.
products.description: A 30ml beard oil that conditions the skin under the beard with jojoba and argan, scented with cedar and sandalwood. Two drops a day keep the itch away and the shine subtle.

products.name: Satin Silk Hair Bonnet
products.description: A mulberry-satin hair bonnet with an adjustable elastic band that stays put overnight. Protects curls and smooths frizz without the flat, sweaty feel of cotton.

products.name: Linen Midi Dress
products.description: A relaxed midi dress in washed European linen with a drawstring waist and side pockets. Cut to move, cool in the heat, and wrinkled in exactly the right places after ten minutes of wear.

products.name: Merino Quarter-Zip Knit
products.shortDescription: Fine merino jumper with quarter zip.
products.description: A fine-gauge merino quarter-zip that layers without bulk and regulates temperature indoors and out. Machine-washable merino with a clean collar and a soft, natural drape.

products.name: Classic Chelsea Boots Tan
products.description: A classic tan chelsea boot in full-grain leather with elastic gussets and a stacked leather sole. Pulls on in seconds, breaks in over a week, and pairs with everything from denim to suiting.

products.name: Pleated Wool Trousers
products.description: Tapered wool-blend trousers with deep front pleats and a gently cropped hem. Tailored enough for the office, unstructured enough for the evening, and elastic-backed for comfort.

products.name: Everyday Cotton Tee (3 Pack)
products.description: Three heavyweight combed-cotton tees in a relaxed, boxy fit that holds its shape wash after wash. Pre-shrunk, tag-free, and the uniform of choice for at least two days a week.

products.name: Rainshell Parka Moss
products.description: A packable three-layer parka in a quiet moss green with fully taped seams and a stowable hood. Winds down into its own pocket and shrugs off a downpour without a wet sleeve.

products.name: Polarized Aviator Sunglasses
products.description: A classic metal aviator with polarized, anti-reflective lenses and a comfortably light frame. The neutral lens keeps colours true, and the fit sits steady through a full day outside.

products.name: Wayfarer Classic Tortoise
products.description: A silhouette-defining acetate wayfarer in a rich tortoise shell with spring hinges and 100% UV lenses. Flatters almost every face and never needs an excuse to be worn.

products.name: Sport Wrap Polarized
products.description: A lightweight wraparound sports frame with polarized lenses and rubber-grip temples that stay put mid-stride. Anti-fog coated and tested for gravel, tarmac, and everything between.

products.name: Cat-Eye Round Vintage
products.shortDescription: Cat-eye frames with a vintage twist.
products.description: A softly angled cat-eye in recycled acetate with a vintage gold accent. Small-batch and comfortably weighted, they bring the same retro confidence to a desk day or a weekend.

products.name: Slim Metal Rectangle
products.description: A slim, minimal rectangle frame in brushed steel with wire temples and gradient lenses. Light enough to forget, sharp enough to notice, and exactly what the name promises.

products.name: Retro Round Blue Tint
products.shortDescription: Round frames with a playful blue lens.
products.description: A round, nostalgic frame with a soft blue tint that turns grey days a little friendlier. UV-filtering and light on the nose, for when you want your sunglasses to do the talking.
